protocol_checks.vulnerability_mechanism: CONFIRMED: in an API-enabled deployment, the untyped AttributeInsert(CipDataType, void*) API can bind one ByteBuf object to writable kCipUdint and kCipByteArray attributes. SetAttrData dispatches the scalar view to DecodeData(kCipUdint), overwriting the low 32 bits of ByteBuf.start while limit remains unchanged; subsequent GetAttrData or SetAttrData dispatch through the byte-array view and BufWriter::append copies against the poisoned start/limit pair. Issue #48 records ASan-confirmed 80-byte out-of-bounds read and write; the default sample is not claimed exploitable.
protocol_checks.atomic_bic: CONFIRMED: 90721b00e44e461d14501bb20714a4d71d9e18e4 is the smallest surviving public first-write of this variant's ByteBuf metadata-trust mechanism. Its diff adds ByteBuf {start, limit}, constructs BufReader/BufWriter from ByteBuf in EncodeData/DecodeData(kCipByteArray), and appends through that view. Blame at affected commit e8e9dba09bf56962807d3504b783ccdb6287f3e4 attributes the relevant casts and append path to 90721b0. Earlier untyped attribute-registration code is a precondition, not the first write of this ByteBuf.start mechanism.
